tcoeAberrantOrig.name: Aberrant Origins
tcoeAberrantOrig.description: As an Aberrant Mind sorcerer, you decide how you acquired your powers. Were you born with them? Or did an event later in life leave you shining with psionic awareness? Consult the Aberrant Origins options for a possible origin of your power.

8IijJiZmfz6hxoSJ.text: A psychic wind from the Astral Plane carried psionic energy to you. When you use your powers, faint motes of light sparkle around you.

cFT1AryTN5jEA5eZ.text: Your nightmares whisper the truth to you: your psionic powers are not your own. You draw them from your parasitic twin!

d3QnYORhDaE3WMiJ.text: As a child, you had an imaginary friend that looked like a flumph or a strange platypus-like creature. One day, it gifted you with psionic powers, which have ended up being not so imaginary.

NxpYyLHLxiOXrO9z.text: ou were implanted with a mind flayer tadpole, but the ceremorphosis never completed. And now its psionic power is yours. When you use it, your flesh shines with a strange mucus.

tukTIR1iSKjXhk3q.text: You were exposed to the Far Realm’s warping influence. You are convinced that a tentacle is now growing on you, but no one else can see it.

Twfyb6hPoDc0rEmd.text: You once suffered the dominating powers of an aboleth, leaving a psychic splinter in your mind.

tcoeAberrationDe.name: Aberration Desires
tcoeAberrationDe.description: Some desired offering options for an aberration.

BH1aEsbfdfpUTtcT.text: Secrets or lore it doesn’t already know

QwbuOC2wbDZzgGAI.text: The brain or other organs of a rare creature

wXE5VZ1Q5iMOVR1c.text: Accepting a strange, organic graft onto your body

9vhJD2ZLvKNchevh.text: Wizened Fixture. A fantastically old, believed-to-be-deceased librarian gives you assignments from the circulation desk they never leave.

99CblkGJwUCpJXHh.text: Spectral Fragment. A haunted piece of the academy’s collection compels you to complete its secret research.

aC5J9S3WoXsHpC9f.text: Distant Observer. A mysterious sponsor encourages your research from afar to avoid alerting nefarious forces embedded within the academy’s bureaucracy.

bOZJ1hGCM5P86AdV.text: Celebrated Instructor. Despite their throngs of ambitious assistants, a celebrity researcher considers you their star pupil.

IXjFWKNUDRy1Mh7K.text: Harried Functionary. A disinterested secretary conveys written correspondence to you from an exceptionally busy or aloof senior faculty member.

xHN2lTPVyphXugda.text: Infatuated Tourist. A flirtatious visiting scholar perceives your every report and donated discovery as a personal gift.

7wYEpws2pt5MOsgl.text: Evolutionary Divinity. You dare to explore what no mortal was meant to know: the origins of divinity.

aDazlQIJouP0Q7sE.text: Restorative Antiquarianism. You track clues leading to plundered artifacts and then restore them to their rightful owners.

h0mhAP87QFA8m0sy.text: Aberrant Zoology. You undertake expeditions to document, capture, and explain beings antithetical to the natural order.

j64WXGdIC9QmVe6T.text: Cryptogeography. You search for proof of a hidden land or that the world isn’t structured as commonly assumed.

tNDbwcyDiQmRAYqm.text: Arcanodynamics. You investigate the ways magic underpins existence, exploring its flows and seeking ways to harness its nexuses.

xAQs4aZz2CrMLLQr.text: Forbidden History. You reveal the lost truths of the world’s darkest ages, pursuing the history of purposefully hidden or taboo eras.

1KDevIpHaYObvC86.text: Museum of Dreams. Magical communication or shared dreamscapes connect a network of wide-ranging specialists.

4ddBd00lmUEU9sus.text: Vault of Secrets. This conspiracy strives to keep or eradicate all knowledge of a specific truth.

ANnEtgySqQsXLD6T.text: Boarding School. Students and faculty enjoy a familial relationship on a self-contained campus.

BhNNnxgMfc5cAxRt.text: Secret Monastery. Ageless secrets remain the focus of contemplation and rigorous training at this site.

Q0vJuwU9eEA9RYEU.text: Arcane Enclave. Drawn together by cutting-edge magical scholarship, the enclave’s residents are hungry for secrets, reagents, and subjects.

utNWhHHOl7rhyhdO.text: Elite Institute. This cutthroat college of science or the arts accepts only the crème de la crème of society and talent.

aNG6n8HYVjeGYfYE.text: Intimate Connection. A common-born confidant or lover of your patron guides you in creating circumstances to bolster the noble family’s best interests.

ed92wkeVat7Ior7o.text: Common Contact. A servant with ambitions toward a title works as a go-between for your patron.

h9ra13Mvwzh5PNII.text: Outsider Inside. A mysterious entity manipulates a noble family’s fortunes. Through your patron, it employs you to help guide its chosen family along a centuries-long course.

MFY8yj5SNRGGrS4t.text: Family Peacemaker. A naive aristocrat appointed by your patron wants your assistance in keeping the peace between fractious family members, which isn’t your patron’s priority.

RV720P77Y9avo6LH.text: Outside Insider. An outcast noble favored by your patron works with you to uphold their family’s interests despite their exile.

SbqmEZk8CGneLsbf.text: Professional. A level-headed advisor or manager of your patron’s business directs you in keeping their reckless employer safe.

cGW3beuXxdct4685.text: Noble Union. You work within multiple noble factions to unite rival families.

di2esZbYEAXx1pLq.text: The New Nobility. You recreate the remarkable event that granted today’s noble families their special standing, enabling the rise of new nobles.

g85RiJbaLiXL2YWL.text: Lost Lineage. You seek evidence of a lost branch of a noble family or proof that individuals don’t possess a noble pedigree.

P2xCORae0INrmX1l.text: Sabotage Rival. You break into the business or estate of an enemy noble family and undermine their political or professional ventures.

SGxXVEBNoxua1ubp.text: Business Breakthrough. You track down and obtain a wonder your patron believes is the key to their financial fortunes.

TXgxGqlYoxAap4BL.text: Origin of Nobility. You reveal the secret reason why certain individuals were elevated to noble status and how they will soon fulfill their purpose.

je9mKYPmB3vB4LdV.text: Merchant Mastermind. Reputation, wealth, and power are one and the same for the head of a family with world-spanning business holdings.

SZZL1GgUdFcPficy.text: Double Dealer. The leader of a noble family has turned against their nation, secretly opposing their liege for personal gain or ethical reasons.

Ubn7pExGkkbH2Wca.text: Nomadic Princeling. Nothing is more appealing to this princeling than treasure. Their sprawling merchant caravan trails behind their palanquin as far as the eye can see.

vYESoEVSVtbfaKRP.text: Future Ruler. This young noble is destined to rule, but currently their whims are fickle and dangerous.

WXbAroqIXcX8nHFu.text: Ambitious Entrepreneur. The sole heir of a vast fortune, this entrepreneur seeks allies to expand their wealth in a new business on the international, global, or planar stage.

XX9JleHE2HYqY43c.text: Local Lord. Convinced that power and prestige lie just around the corner, this minor lordling grasps for every opportunity to climb the ranks.

tcoeBeastDesires.name: Beast Desires
tcoeBeastDesires.description: Some desired offering options for a beast.

4KeystNQ2nou0Png.text: Brightly colored beads, cloth, feathers, or string

b297x6MvMxbelo1M.text: An old stuffed animal or other soft trinket

AJj05tBVO9hwZgtQ.text: Back-Room Dealers. An exclusive area in an otherwise-ordinary establishment requires a password or token to gain entry. There you meet and communicate with shadowy agents of your patron.

d32vg2QhWSPnCuDU.text: Visions. Your patron doesn’t use intermediaries, instead speaking to you in dreams, omens, or visions. The being appears in your mind as you sleep, taking control of your dreams to deliver instructions that become difficult to ignore.

fQ7SvCngwS7v7oEC.text: Ephemeral Echo. Your contact never physically reveals itself to you. Perhaps it is the ghost of a dead person, an entity that appears outside the flow of time, or a projected illusion of a being that never leaves your patron’s hidden sanctum.

jKWZLQzRsAQ8sVkK.text: Employer. An established member of local society acts as the interface between you and the patron and provides the cover of legitimate employment. They could be a bartender, shopkeeper, local official, or noble.

OyjEsLZCNiyGvrEN.text: The Mouthpiece. The ancient being’s voice whispers through the lips of an ordinary person. You patron might posses the body of a stranger or a party member to converse with you.

XhvMaRZedJJrzxrm.text: Magical Message Drop. Magically recorded messages from your contact or your patron appear in odd places. You know to check a predetermined location, such as a crack in an ancient monolith or a specific grave, for instructions.

4QSQthUJgDXbLfye.text: Astral Heist. A powerful rival of your patron stores their secrets in a mind vault on the Astral Plane. That means they can’t be tricked or coerced into revealing anything, nor can their thoughts be read. You must find the vault and travel through the rival’s deadly memories to find the knowledge your patron desires.

cKh1KisW5vmG9lre.text: Rescue. A wayward agent went missing while gathering information or materials. You must discover their fate and recover them and their findings.

dstcyPkfm0U7g7Ff.text: Sabotage. You must destroy an aspect of a rival’s organization, either assassinating a key minion or destroying a critical object.

N2eHeTP2qZpXnkfk.text: Treachery. A high-profile minion of another powerful figure is in a position to betray their master, to the benefit of your patron. You must convince them to defect to your organization or extract them from now-hostile territory.

QeMXHunIZZhQtaIU.text: Culling. A respected agent of your patron (possibly an ally or a mentor for your group) has been compromised. Perhaps they are defecting to a rival, attempting to seize the ancient being’s power. Whatever the case, you must catch them to end their threat.

z6B7eP6VaKS1Sh9w.text: Artifice. Your specialized skills are instrumental to assembling components for a powerful magic ritual or object.

6DqtJ8jCMtdsFEF8.text: Guardian Celestial. An angel or another powerful celestial takes an interest in a specific region of the Material Plane. It cultivates a network of mortal informants and agents to serve its agenda.

DQmMkm6M9YlkY9YH.text: Elder Dragon. An ancient dragon seeks knowledge or power. It wishes to gather greater wealth for its hoard, its ambitions expanding in its advancing years.

M2azde1zFdzCTHYk.text: Bound Fiend. This fiend is bound to a location, either in its true form or as a possessing spirit. Whether trapped in an unbreakable circle of binding sigils or sealed as a spirit within a gigantic statue, the fiend’s influence drives your group.

SqxZJk6eJtlWtm7t.text: The Endless. This person has lived many lifetimes because they can’t die—at least not permanently. No matter the cause of their demise, they return. To all appearances, they are alive and mortal, but they control the amassed resources of an immortal.

w9ikQ4ZtoduBXfnC.text: Primal Manifestation. Its existence defies mortal understanding; the being simply is. It could be a primordial force of nature awakened to self-awareness that now inhabits the landscape or an alien intellect that whispers through proxies, omens, and idols.

yZIkafNmrLNFumA0.text: Lich. An undead spellcaster of immense power employs your group. Its interests are strangely diverse and seemingly benign. Perhaps it’s not as evil as conventional adventuring wisdom suggests?

tcoeBlessedRadia.name: Blessed Radiance Effects
tcoeBlessedRadia.description: An effect that can occur when in a supernatural Blessed Radiance region.

1zALeSlVn9h7y2eY.text: One character in the region feels a profound sense of purpose and gains the benefit of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.8dzaICjGy6mTUaUr]{bless} spell for 1 minute. They can choose two other creatures they can see to gain the spell’s benefits as well.

8zrdJ7j1S58ScB9H.text: One character in the region hears whispers from celestial beings or refrains of celestial choirs. The character can ask those voices one question as if using the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.d54VDyFulD9xxY7J]{commune} spell.

epprwHw4JNtl8955.text: Aberrations, fiends, and undead in the region give off a crimson glow for 1 minute. The creatures shed dim light in a 10-foot radius, attacks against them have advantage if the attacker can see them, and the creatures can’t benefit from being &Reference[invisible].

F3MHe08m0mOFZaAf.text: Celestial power explodes in a 30-foot-radius sphere of divine light centered on an aberration, a fiend, or an undead creature within the region. Each creature in the sphere must make a [[/save constitution dc=15]] saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes [[/damage 4d6 type=radiant]] damage and is &Reference[blinded]. On a success, it takes half damage and isn’t blinded.

fL1e7EJ1RU7QQgse.text: Golden light fills a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on one character in the region and then fades. That character and their friends in the cylinder gain the benefits of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.8MICCMeOXT3aJUy9]{divine favor} spell for 1 hour.

i4B0nOv1lcdFURYL.text: A booming voice thunders in Celestial and can be heard throughout the region. Each creature in the region must make a [[/save constitution dc=15]] saving throw. On a success, the creature gains [[/r 2d10]] temporary hit points. On a failure, the creature is &Reference[deafened] for 1 minute.

me89KPLHSatk6NSs.text: One simple or martial weapon that is nonmagical and carried by one character in the region gains the properties of a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.items.Item.m7RubLd1lUcMjYgY]{mace of disruption} for 24 hours.

MGMk7a7Ktnv8cCqQ.text: Aberrations, fiends, and undead in the region have disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks for the next 24 hours.

nLXc5cOApQisVNpB.text: An angelic voice rings throughout the region. Each creature there must succeed on a [[/save wisdom dc=15]] saving throw or perform the grovel option of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.arzCrMRgcNiQuh43]{command} spell.

OZxv6mw6ZalUYQbG.text: One character in the region permanently gains resistance to necrotic damage. Reroll if you’ve already rolled this effect.

P77rzQV7hMAbsmOH.text: Each creature carrying the holy symbol of a deity from a non-evil plane while in the region gains advantage on saving throws for the next 24 hours.

tcmuwes8HVDDyFef.text: The effects of a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.SLxA9QhrggTz0taU]{hallow} spell (save DC 17), with one of its extra effects (DM’s choice), settle over the region for 24 hours.

uAJzgXULlmPeaQ4K.text: One character in the region gains the ability to cure afflictions for 1 hour. As an action, they can cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.F0GsG0SJzsIOacwV]{lesser restoration} or @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.WzvJ7G3cqvIubsLk]{greater restoration} without expending a spell slot and requiring no material components.

WGm60hIu6FBcoR1P.text: One character in the region gains the ability to use the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.classfeatures.Item.eVXqHn0ojWrEuYGU]{Divine Intervention} cleric feature, which succeeds automatically. The character can use the feature granted in this way only once and must use it within 7 days. Reroll if you’ve already rolled this effect.

ww3LfxwQD7aDUl3U.text: A flying, gleaming sword (use the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-tashas-cauldron.tcoe-actors.Actor.EqJUA3Z3181RSSFU]{flying sword} stat block which is configured with radiant damage) appears within 60 feet of an aberration, a fiend, or an undead, which becomes the sword’s target. The sword deals radiant damage instead of slashing damage and knows the exact location of its target while the target is within the region. The sword vanishes when it or its target is reduced to 0 hit points.

ZIEy53fOvTqJlfyQ.text: Radiant energy erupts in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on one random creature in the region. Each creature in the sphere that isn’t undead regains 3d6 hit points. Each undead creature in the sphere takes 3d6 radiant damage.

zyAbl7w5EHXlMnss.text: One character in the region is suffused with celestial power. For 1 minute, the character’s melee attacks deal an extra [[/damage 2d6 type=radiant]] damage on a hit.

tcoeCelestialDes.description: Some desired offering options for a celestial.

Ad8azT84Xw3iuqqT.text: A holy relic or treasured family heirloom

wMRcQxdZZeiaIOEX.text: An oath to do three charitable deeds before dawn

tcoeConstructDes.description: Some desired offering options for a construct.

5fwgnKNU4kfruWg3.text: A vessel infused with elemental power

BoXTxTaNen8x0Bzx.text: Oil to apply to the construct’s joints

mQ455QFf0c8T3Z89.text: A magic item with charges, to be used as fuel

tcoeDragonDesire.name: Dragon Desires
tcoeDragonDesire.description: Some desired offering options for a dragon.

JdKyxjjz8RXoHLSO.text: A flattering artistic depiction of the dragon

nGwvzXFyju8h9asL.text: Anything from a draconic rival’s hoard

wGOllr5sHdiA1qLN.text: An antique passed down at least three generations

tcoeElementalDes.name: Elemental Desires
tcoeElementalDes.description: Some desired offering options for an elemental.

3PdB3FchQd3VaV0O.text: A gem worth at least 50 gp, which the creature eats

4KJfpQfusPpA8a9E.text: An exceedingly pure sample of a favored element

eDhjXSM9BGzGMlkN.text: A way to return the elemental to its home plane

PpVak8jq1V9N7T2E.text: Performing a dance from the elemental’s home plane

tcoeElementalEss.name: Elemental Essence and Property
tcoeElementalEss.description: Use this table to determine a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-tashas-cauldron.tcoe-magic-items.Item.tcoeElementalEss]{shard's} essence and property. When you use a Metamagic option on a spell while you are holding or wearing the shard, you can use that property.

qBXxaflvH9Jc757j.text: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-tashas-cauldron.tcoe-magic-items.Item.tcoeEarthEssence]{Earth.} You gain &Reference[damageresistance]{resistance} to a damage type of your choice until the start of your next turn.

RsljOTtT61i2vvVi.text: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-tashas-cauldron.tcoe-magic-items.Item.tcoeWaterEssence]{Water.} You create a wave of water that bursts out from you in a 10-foot radius. Each creature of your choice that you can see in that area takes [[/damage 2d6 type=cold]] damage and must succeed on a [[/save ability=str]] saving throw against your spell save DC or be pushed 10 feet away from you and fall &Reference[prone].

UdbjLWCDmcyMnfXx.text: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-tashas-cauldron.tcoe-magic-items.Item.tcoeAirEssenceSh]{Air.} You can immediately fly up to 60 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

xdgUD0YbcflWVMyV.text: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-tashas-cauldron.tcoe-magic-items.Item.tcoeFireEssenceS]{Fire.} One target of the spell that you can see catches fire. The burning target takes [[/damage 2d10 type=fire]] damage at the start of its next turn, and then the flames go out.

tcoeEnchantedSpr.name: Enchanted Spring Effects
tcoeEnchantedSpr.description: Effects that can occur in an enchanted spring.

8dJkFWA2pysFJNw5.text: Bathing in the spring grants a creature the benefits of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.KJRVzeMQXPj8Gtyx]{spider climb} spell for 24 hours.

45dLQ1yyxyPXE259.text: A creature that touches or drinks the water of this spring grows the tail of its favorite animal. The tail is not under the creature’s control; it moves or reacts to emotions. The tail vanishes after 24 hours.

bp1lBbO3wKUZG6o5.text: A creature that touches or drinks the water of this spring grows a set of donkey ears. The ears grant the creature advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing. The ears vanish after [[/r 1d4]] days.

Bw4lruX8rY0115Gs.text: Bathing in the spring causes [[/r 1d10]] flowers to grow from a creature’s head. The flowers smell lovely, and they renew their vitality and scent every day. The flowers vanish after 7 days.

djDGx4a2p4Cbr3v7.text: Bathing in the spring causes a creature to develop a third eye on its forehead. The eye grants the creature &Reference[truesight] out to a range of 60 feet. The eye vanishes after 24 hours.

eSvgKcWHHAMaVvZV.text: Bathing in the spring causes a creature’s voice to sound sinister. For the next 24 hours, the creature’s voice grants it advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks and disadvantage on Charisma (Deception) and Charisma (Persuasion) checks.

N1CIFipEUEx9ZXYg.text: Any creature that touches or drinks the water of this spring feels blessed. The creature gains the benefits of a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.8dzaICjGy6mTUaUr]{bless} spell for 1 hour.

onIV6baZABlP435q.text: A creature that touches or drinks the water of this spring grows [[/r 1d4]] eyestalks. These eyestalks let the creature see in all directions and grant it advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight. The eyestalks vanish after [[/r 1d4]] days.

QOnfWA6ja0Oe7SpO.text: A creature that touches or drinks the water of this spring develops an overwhelming desire to sing. Every sentence the creature speaks for the next 24 hours rings with lyrical splendor, which grants it advantage on all Charisma checks.

rMeXkXWEWEci5UnI.text: Bathing in the spring covers a creature with a glowing coat of golden feathers. While the creature isn’t wearing armor, the feathers grant a +1 bonus to AC. The feathers vanish after [[/r 1d4]] days.

SdXKBvaM2ZZO2FYf.text: Bathing in the spring grants a creature the benefits of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.WzvJ7G3cqvIubsLk]{greater restoration} spell. As a side effect, the creature’s skin, hair, and eyes become a shimmering golden color for [[/r 1d4]] days.

TVFcN66swPMxusId.text: Any creature with an Intelligence score of 6 or higher that touches or drinks the water of this spring gains advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks and can cast the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.ppWAAEul0QHtm4er]{detect thoughts} spell once, requiring no components. The effects of the spring fade when either the spell is used or 24 hours pass, whichever happens first.

tcoeExtraplanarR.name: Extraplanar Reversal
tcoeExtraplanarR.description: Failing Matrix. Whenever the Crook of Rao’s Absolute Banishment property is used, or when its last charge is expended, roll on the Extraplanar Reversal table. Any creatures conjured as a result of this effect appear in random unoccupied spaces within 60 feet of you and are not under your control.

8O8y96iYHfn4dTO3.text: 1 @UUID[Compendium.dnd-tashas-cauldron.tcoe-actors.Actor.uZ8NrRenwYZ4qNf6]{balor} and 1 @UUID[Compendium.dnd-tashas-cauldron.tcoe-actors.Actor.RCv5y7iWlfNxkinx]{pit fiend} appear. At the DM’s discretion, a portal opens into the presence of an archdevil or demon lord instead, then closes after 5 minutes.

CtfLdWOHWiA6cPsk.text: Iggwilv’s Curse (see the Iggwilv’s Curse property).

YDdAMV4A2o9vtnHj.text: A portal to a random plane opens. The portal closes after 5 minutes.

tcoeFarRealmCrea.name: Far Realm Effects: Creatures
tcoeFarRealmCrea.description: Options that can occur as part of a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-tashas-cauldron.tcoe-tables.RollTable.tcoeFarRealmEffe]{Far Realm Effect}.

75yonW4k9w1LiA1R.text: An @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.OVikYmSdHliAG2YD]{insect plague} spell is centered on one random creature in the region.

c432Q6shOySDza14.text: [[/r 1d4]] swarms of @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.LPdX5YLlwci0NDZx]{ravens} and [[/r 1d4]] @UUID[Compendium.dnd-tashas-cauldron.tcoe-actors.Actor.8ihbbjkaOFTPbI73]{swarms of rats} gather and attack any other creatures in the region.

PLzhHyvMWFTw3P59.text: A @UUID[Compendium.dnd-tashas-cauldron.tcoe-actors.Actor.NB6wUgVqeOQtsQKu]{treant} (in forested terrain) or a galeb duhr (in rockier terrain) attacks.

tcoeFarRealmEffe.name: Far Realm Effects
tcoeFarRealmEffe.description: An effect that can occur when in a supernatural Far Realm region.

1D98pFNEuCMbgBu2.text: Glaring eyes, which weep viscid tears, appear on inanimate objects throughout the region. These eyes watch the characters, and creatures within the region can’t be surprised by the characters for as long as the eyes exist. An eye closes and disappears if it takes any damage. Reroll if you’ve already rolled this effect.

6BWaMQLrg11nXQis.text: Natural features and structures in this region writhe to spell out words and form strange symbols. Any creature that tries to read the messages must make a [[/check skill=arc dc=20]] check. On a success, the creature gains insight as if it had cast the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.dSTu1MaPhBqPITwM]{contact other plane} spell. On a failure, the creature is affected as if it failed a saving throw against the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.9hQXdMSmerkTsHDe]{confusion} spell. This effect ends at the end of the creature’s next turn.

bpCJl2Jzn2eWQAts.text: A tear in reality creates a rift in the region, similar to the spell gate, that passes through the Far Realm and connects with a random plane. Any creature that enters the rift takes [[/damage 10d10 type=psychic]] from the horrors of the Far Realm and appears in an empty space closest to the rift’s opening on another random plane. The rift vanishes after [[/r 2d10 + 2]] hours.

dyd7SAfKvCYlBkJg.text: One random creature in the region hears strange whispers and must succeed on a [[/save wisdom dc=14]] saving throw or become &Reference[charmed]. While charmed in this way, the creature focuses on copying the blasphemous designs that appear in its mind using whatever medium it has available (ink, charcoal, mud, or its own blood). Unless &Reference[restrained], the creature completes the designs in 1 hour of work. When the creature finishes its work, it is no longer charmed, and a death slaad appears within 30 feet of it and attacks anyone in sight.

ebLW3pFRXMPgQsOl.text: A structure in the region whispers faintly. Any creature within 60 feet of the structure that can hear it must succeed on a [[/save wisdom dc=12]] saving throw or be &Reference[charmed]. While charmed in this way, the creature must move toward the source of the whispering, avoiding obvious hazards. When it reaches the source, it is &Reference[incapacitated]. The creature can repeat the saving throw when it takes damage and at the end of every hour, ending the effect on itself on a success.

efVKgoQq3KQlO2Ze.text: Unintelligible murmurings threaten to overcome the mind of one random creature within the region. At the start of the creature’s turn, it must succeed on a [[/save intelligence dc=13]] saving throw or use its action to make one melee attack against the nearest creature it can see. If there are no other creatures within reach, the target spends its action babbling.

fqs9wouuRwtO1pQm.text: The landscape melts into a mass of writhing flesh, eyes, and fanged mouths. From an unoccupied space in the fleshy ground arise [[/r 1d4 + 5]] @UUID[Compendium.dnd-tashas-cauldron.tcoe-actors.Actor.8pX2JhWUpTNNRBVx]{gibbering mouthers} that attack anyone in sight.

JuHlcYtEaIqaPn43.text: An elder evil turns its attention to the region, imposing the pressure of its unfathomable presence upon the place. Any creature that finishes a rest in the region must succeed on a [[/save charisma dc=12]] saving throw, or it gains no benefit from finishing the rest. It instead finds strange scrawls, stacked stones, or its belongings arranged in intricate, abstruse patterns nearby.

OT22gHmPVM3wxeXD.text: Bizarre appendages squirm beneath the ground and around trees or other structures within this region. Dozens of limbs burst forth, entangling anyone within a 30-foot sphere surrounding one random creature. Each creature in the sphere must succeed on a [[/save dexterity dc=14]] saving throw or take [[/damage 3d6 type=bludgeoning]] damage and be &Reference[restrained]. Any creature that ends its turn in the area takes [[/damage 3d6 type=bludgeoning]] damage. A creature can free itself or someone else within reach from being restrained in this way by using an action to make a successful [[/check strength dc=14]] or [[/check dexterity dc=14]] check (its choice).

OYilWtjh5CalfeSg.text: Distance no longer functions in a comprehensible manner within the region. Creatures make ranged attack rolls with disadvantage, and the range of those attacks is halved.

xVK2YkxNAfGQ1oPQ.text: In this region, circular things (such as buttons, crystal balls, the sun, and so on) seem appallingly wrong. One random creature that starts its turn in this region must succeed on a [[/save intelligence dc=14]] saving throw or spend their turn loudly trying to destroy these objects.

Yk3FO5YMtUeos8Vo.text: Creatures in the region can’t leave it and find themselves covering the same ground over and over. By the time they realize this, [[/r 2d10]] hours have passed, during which they have made no progress in their effort to leave. The effect then ends, and each creature must succeed on a [[/save constitution dc=10]] saving throw or gain 1 level of &Reference[exhaustion].

tcoeFeyDesires00.name: Fey Desires
tcoeFeyDesires00.description: Some desired offering options for a fey.

e1IPPpUTYvU9ZJq3.text: An object of deep sentimental value to you

pJPSTcT85R4Z5S4V.text: The memory of your first kiss

tcoeFeywildGifts.name: Feywild Gifts
tcoeFeywildGifts.description: As a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-tashas-cauldron.tcoe-character-options.Item.tcoeFeyWanderer0]{Fey Wanderer}, you also possess a preternatural blessing from a fey ally or a place of fey power. Choose your blessing from this table or determine it randomly.

68RSuLJMq6I1fk7K.text: Illusory butterflies flutter around you while you take a short or long rest.

cNoa1pomoPmm1RbB.text: Fresh, seasonal flowers sprout from your hair each dawn.

GzSwjlOrNOrJrbb8.text: Horns or antlers sprout from your head.

io8AOnmcwkK8UUzk.text: Your skin and hair change color to match the season at each dawn.

qiEgOLYZ5t2NfAlI.text: Your shadow dances while no one is looking directly at it.

qsaz2Gsd2hUHCAF7.text: You faintly smell of cinnamon, lavender, nutmeg, or another comforting herb or spice.

tcoeFiendDesires.name: Fiend Desires
tcoeFiendDesires.description: Some desired offering options for a fiend.

eAH87FTfxRorgCwu.text: Blood from a living or recently slain loved one

NXq1Y92LvG5kPS0P.text: Breaking a sacred promise in the fiend’s presence

tcoeGenieKind000.name: Genie Kind
tcoeGenieKind000.description:
You have made a pact with one of the rarest kinds of genie, a noble genie. Such entities rule vast fiefs on the Elemental Planes and have great influence over lesser genies and elemental creatures. Noble genies are varied in their motivations, but most are arrogant and wield power that rivals that of lesser deities. They delight in turning the table on mortals, who often bind genies into servitude, and readily enter into pacts that expand their reach.

You choose your patron’s kind or determine it randomly, using the below options.

tcoeGeniesVessel.name: Genie's Vessel
tcoeGeniesVessel.description: Your patron gifts you a magical vessel that grants you a measure of the genie’s power. The vessel is a Tiny object, and you can use it as a spellcasting focus for your warlock spells. You decide what the object is, or you can determine what it is randomly by rolling on the table below:

tcoeGiantDesires.name: Giant Desires
tcoeGiantDesires.description: Some desired offering options for a giant.

5Ko4Kt2aF3kgQYMs.text: A dwarf admitting giant-craft to be superior to dwarf-craft

aIGl8y8XIVfbcQO3.text: Treasure stolen from a rival giant

4pdtZUO2YspdmJpM.text: Attentive Overseer. A guild representative takes personal interest in your group’s tasks. They follow your exploits and know of your adventures before you return to report. Despite the unsettling depth of their knowledge, they seem genuinely eager to shepherd your work.

GEqgyzvMVFbQSMep.text: Hidden Benefactor. Whoever your contact is, they don’t communicate directly. They send messages via couriers or letters. No one in the guild knows who the contact is, or if they do, they aren’t telling you. Regardless, the contact’s information is good, and they pay on time.

heDsFhcA8bIzHCYS.text: The Perfectionist. Your contact is a skilled but obsessive creator consumed with the quest to create something perfect that will define their life’s work and secure their legacy. They lose sight of right and wrong in pursuit of the finest materials and exciting opportunities.

rWNqxwjQGjMBXhCO.text: Fallen Muse. Your contact is a fallen celestial. Whether they regret their transgressions or hunger for vengeance, they provide divine inspiration and guidance to you and to the guild. Somehow your group and the guild inspire their hope for ascension.

tOT8ufDBcFmLKq0E.text: Discerning Mentor. No matter how well you perform, or how perfect your creations, nothing is ever good enough for this contact. They point out every flaw and missed opportunity. Are they bitter, lashing out at anyone around them, or do they recognize your potential and try to push you to greatness?

XebHDtFm7Hn3ReTn.text: Golem Guide. Your guild contact is the soul of a long-dead artisan preserved in a construct body. This golem is wise and knowledgeable, but it has difficulty grasping the passage of time and the state of the world compared to its original era.

ebsluT7yWFXXHFat.text: The Bill Comes Due. Your guild master achieved their vaunted position by means of an otherworldly bargain. That price has come due, and they are desperate to avoid paying. You must defeat whatever’s coming to collect the master’s debt or find another acceptable payment.

eV8AZFBvyasRBCRt.text: Deliver Goods. You need to deliver an order to an important customer or partner of the guild. The delivery must arrive by a critical deadline—regardless of who or what tries to stop you.

KFGepCsd7YhOTrBU.text: Eliminate a Rival. A competitor has humiliated the guild one too many times, and it’s time for that to stop. Your group is charged with ensuring the rival never besmirches the guild’s reputation again. Can you trick them into permanent disgrace, or must you resort to more direct methods?

lmU6qk1gyW3GacwJ.text: Acquire Materials. Your guild requires materials that are rare and difficult to procure, either for a guild project or for a paying client. Your group must gather the missing components from a dangerous location or a recalcitrant owner while outpacing a rival to the prize.

Mip7q9L0WE9KdbwA.text: The Collector. Your guild is tasked to create or acquire something wondrous for a wealthy but secretive client’s collection. Guild members who previously failed to fulfill this assignment ended up missing. The collector promises to return your comrades if you provide what the collector seeks, but if you fail, you’ll become part of the collection.

VaUBuW1tgNtYf40X.text: The Masterpiece. An exquisite work of art for an influential client, either created by your guild or acquired through agents, has gone missing. You must track down its whereabouts and secure it before time runs out and the guild suffers a penalty.

0mpglL6SxRBRY2nq.text: Moneychangers. These merchants deal in all forms of currency, acting as bankers, loan agents, and crucial contacts for adventurers and other individuals who deal with large sums of wealth. They exchange coin for gemstones as readily as they find buyers for historical relics and recovered art.

aaYaSgysbuiHPo9y.text: Merchant Consortium. These entrepreneurs don’t create the wares they peddle, instead specializing in linking products to prospective owners. If they don’t have it, they find it.

BMbM7SRvw1gZDsPJ.text: Miracle Makers’ Association. The magically inclined crafters of this guild specialize in imbuing physical goods with magical effects. Rumor has it they can strip the magic from existing enchanted items and might be willing to buy or trade adventurers’ spoils.

Ff0VPY74kAIT3qBS.text: Crafters’ Guild. This conglomerate of artisans pools its resources and influence to ensure a steady exchange of gold for its crafts.

qNwQ8eiPNsvCK19b.text: Philosophical Faction. These like-minded individuals follow specific teachings, spreading word of their expertise through their services and training.

S4P8rYlmpZnS5lt1.text: Identity Traders. These enigmatic dealers buy and sell documents, memories, and the trappings of thoroughly lived lives, selling them to those in need of the ultimate fresh start.

tcoeHauntedEffec.name: Haunted Effects
tcoeHauntedEffec.description: An effect that can occur when in a supernatural Haunted region.

0N0CkvtWLHRmS1T7.text: One random creature in the region is targeted by the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.MRxldJd6C4bsBo3O]{levitate} spell (save DC 15) for 1 minute.

1BkOlhjYXSFJpqZe.text: All bright light weakens to dim light for 24 hours. Sources that provide dim light, such as candles, do not shed any light.

6HhOXibiDN5Alym3.text: A nonviolent but unsettling @UUID[Compendium.dnd-tashas-cauldron.tcoe-actors.Actor.qoFEjfrANBdrCP6m]{ghost}—perhaps a pet, an accident-prone child, or a dismembered big toe—appears and follows one random creature for 24 hours before vanishing. The ghost vanishes if reduced to 0 hit points.

8n71A1BevPYal1WF.text: After the next sunset, the sun doesn’t rise again for 36 hours. During this time, the sky over the region might hold a crimson moon, be obscured by roiling fog, or display blinking, alien stars.

Aqc4njHZCyCgR9tP.text: For the next 24 hours, any humanoid killed in the region rapidly decomposes and rises as a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-tashas-cauldron.tcoe-actors.Actor.nU8GN8La8DCt8SDb]{skeleton} [[/r 1d10]] minutes after dying.

d2u1Oal7XNzN0Pr1.text: A coffin or small enclosed space in the region—perhaps an antique box, stone cairn, or tree stump sealed with rocks—radiates palpable malice. The first time a creature opens it, roll a die ([[/r 1d2]]. If you roll an even number, the creature receives a terrible vision and is &Reference[frightened] of all creatures for the next 24 hours. If you roll an odd number, an @UUID[Compendium.dnd-tashas-cauldron.tcoe-actors.Actor.XiSWKZzAUxdmFOLL]{avatar of death} appears and attacks as though summoned by the Skull card from a deck of many things.

E7thyu0PD019CddI.text: During the next night, one random sleeping creature vanishes and reappears approximately a foot beneath where they were sleeping—typically buried in undisturbed dirt or in a space beneath floorboards. The creature or someone else can free it with a successful [[/check skill=ath dc=13]] check.

GAQPwyCpg3HAIwxm.text: Over the next 24 hours, whenever any creature is wounded, its blood (or similar fluid) spreads to form a short message or grisly tableau.

icpikgsENntGyhBk.text: During the next night, one sleeping character in the region receives a vision as if the target of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.kSPRpeIx3w3nihrF]{dream} spell. The dream is brief and unsettling, revealing some element of the environment’s history and putting the character in the place of someone who suffered a grim fate there.

IJJuFK7NbyUaatnv.text: A spirit inhabits one character’s simple or martial weapon, making it a sentient magic item until the character leaves the region. Randomly generate the item’s properties as described in the “Sentient Magic Items” section of the Dungeon Master’s Guide.

LGOICbxExL5Khfsj.text: A mysterious mist rises from the shadows. This dense fog heavily obscures everything in a 50-foot-radius sphere around one random creature in the region. Any creature that starts its turn in the mist must succeed on a [[/save constitution dc=10]] saving throw or gain 1 level of &Reference[exhaustion]. This exhaustion can’t be removed while the creature is in the mist. Additionally, creatures notice unsettling sights through the fog, such as ominous ruins or soundless silhouettes fleeing pursuit. The mists can’t be dispersed by any wind, but clear after 1 minute.

Mjch7kOdtBuGFIty.text: A spectral force manifests to one character in the region, allowing them to ask one question and receive a short answer as through the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.4v2H3hHb3Ph9XLNd]{augury} spell. The force manifests as a planchette moving on a talking board, writing on foggy glass, or insects swarming to create messages.

opxT3t6oIgocQiHZ.text: A violent thunderstorm begins, centered over the region. It doesn’t end until the party leaves the region.

p1QjbkGQzcvS2kiS.text: One player character’s appearance changes for the next 24 hours to reflect the region’s haunted history. For example, they might manifest the distinctive facial scar associated with a notorious tyrant who died in the region.

rHw260RGWQkwvjcA.text: A mundane part of one random character’s surroundings—perhaps a tree bole or a stuffed animal head—animates for 1 minute and whispers a warning or threatens to reveal one of the character’s secrets.

S74NWVLlDIqymabZ.text: For 24 hours, a luminous wisp of vapor floats above a corpse or grave in the region. If the wisp is put in a container, a creature holding the receptacle can cast the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.jhhT9PsHy5A7EojO]{resurrection} spell once, requiring no components and causing the wisp to vanish. Any creature returned to life in this way experiences strange dreams.

WEtYlFKDk8se8i2s.text: The temperature in the region drops by 10 degrees Fahrenheit every hour for the next [[/r 1d6]] hours, after which the temperature returns to normal. If cold enough, ice crystals form in sinister patterns.

WggrOI0F3rOdTjoQ.text: One random creature’s shadow acts independently for the next 24 hours. The shadow acts out of sync with its owner, perhaps dramatically choking or trying to murder another shadow.

x7dMf4vkpItj1HY5.text: Over the next 24 hours, whenever any creature in the region regains hit points from a spell, the healing magic leaves scars. This might be accompanied by a purging of black bile or a spectral force tearing free from the creature. These scars can be removed only by @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.WzvJ7G3cqvIubsLk]{greater restoration} or @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.3okM6Gn63zzEULkz]{wish}.

yoENy4y1NUHfkUSh.text: A random building in the region gains the benefits of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.yw0tYQkOMCgKZ8Ur]{guards and wards} spell (save DC 13) for the next 24 hours.

tcoeHumanoidDesi.name: Humanoid Desires
tcoeHumanoidDesi.description: Some desired offering options for a humanoid.

koaYkD2ktaY3NZ9D.text: Challenging them to a type of friendly contest, such as dancing, singing, or drinking

m2fvpg4Cwjircd2d.text: Promising to find a lost item of great importance to their culture

pnhw5A5uYjqrGeKe.text: Information on a foe’s secrets or weaknesses

tcoeInfestedEffe.name: Infested Effects
tcoeInfestedEffe.description: An effect that can occur when in a supernatural Infected region.

0DvYXm5TyNq3qdG9.text: The ground opens up beneath one random creature, creating a quicksand pit (see the Dungeon Master’s Guide).

5ZlXV6vIW0B6lw5s.text: A mass migration of insects begins, with waves of Tiny bugs crawling over everything in the region. Creatures cannot take a short or long rest in the region for the next 24 hours.

7qlFVaVuGK2mceOQ.text: A cricket-shaped creature with the statistics of a cat bounds up to one random creature and follows it like an affectionate pet for 24 hours before scampering off.

51yzP2pkIasFm7zR.text: A cluster of [[/r 1d4 + 2]] faintly glowing grubs appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of the party. Any creature that consumes one of these succulent grubs receives the benefits of a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.items.Item.ytlsBjYsZ7OBSEBs]{potion of healing}.

aPVnbp1rzewG7IzX.text: Intense buzzing or grinding noises fill the region for the next 24 hours. With the exception of truly cacophonous sounds, creatures can only hear speech and noises that originate within 10 feet of them.

b45mxeRy7zcYLAKC.text: A swarm of bioluminescent flies converges on one random creature in the region. For the next minute, the creature sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius, any attack against it has advantage if the attacker can see it, and the creature can’t benefit from being &Reference[invisible].

eD3bLBltCcCRytqO.text: A boil of termites bursts from the ground, along with dozens of bones and a treasure of the DM’s choice (see “Random Treasure” in the Dungeon Master’s Guide).

hZE0h40dIAVoRp2t.text: Countless tiny, bloodsucking insects infest the region for the next [[/r 1d6]] hours. Every hour, each creature in the region must succeed on a [[/save constitution dc=10]] saving throw or gain 1 level of &Reference[exhaustion]. The insects don’t affect creatures that are immune to disease.

Ifnvhp0jMwPH9EvU.text: One of the characters in the region must succeed on a [[/save wisdom dc=15]] saving throw or be transformed into a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-tashas-cauldron.tcoe-actors.Actor.v99wOosUJjUgcUNF]{giant spider}, as if by the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.04nMsTWkIFvkbXlY]{polymorph} spell. The spell lasts for 1 hour or until dispelled.

M7riuPSWqKMVFkzW.text: A massive, bloated maggot emerges from the ground within 10 feet of the party and bursts, covering the ground with ichor in a 10-foot square centered on it. This region is affected by the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.etgcR9wqmrhyZ0tx]{grease} spell ([[/save dex dc=13]] saving throw) for 1 minute.

mWj6UhcLLRPA7CJv.text: One random creature in the region must succeed on a [[/save constitution dc=16]] saving throw or become host to a particularly aggressive tapeworm. The affected creature gains no benefit from eating until it receives treatment that removes a disease. A creature immune to disease automatically succeeds on this saving throw.

pEMXcmcRjwFu4CRV.text: Nearly every surface is covered with discarded cicada-like shells that crunch loudly when trod upon, imposing disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made while moving across them. The shells vanish after 1 hour.

RkIaGvaj6bg5nhpy.text: Dung-colored bugs cover the ground. Creatures that move at half their normal walking speed can ignore the bugs. Those that move faster must succeed on a [[/save constitution dc=16]] saving throw or become &Reference[poisoned] until the start of their next turn. A creature poisoned in this way has its speed reduced to 0, as it is overcome by the squashed insects’ foul smell. Creatures that don’t need to breathe automatically succeed on this saving throw.

uL0SoXG6Q5e1HJVf.text: One random creature in the region must succeed on a [[/save constitution dc=16]] saving throw, or it acquires a ravenous silverfish infestation among its gear. The infestation is discovered the next time the creature finishes a short or long rest. If the creature has any paper material, the silverfish destroy one random book or other paper item that isn’t magical.

WxMVQbMS4cs0OlWd.text: One random creature in the region must succeed on a [[/save constitution dc=16]] saving throw or contract the sight rot disease (see the Dungeon Master’s Guide) from minute parasites.

XH2vnykyvqKFSoI7.text: The region is choked with wispy webbing, which acts as &Reference[difficult-terrain].

Xp0C3tUUwjwf7rTu.text: Biting mites infest creatures’ clothing in the region. Any creature wearing medium or heavy armor has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws for the next 24 hours.

y7IXvs1DCaWVYzol.text: Tiny arachnids invade unattended spaces. The next time one random creature in the region dons its clothing or armor after finishing a long rest, it must succeed on a [[/save constitution dc=16]] saving throw or take [[/damage 2d10 type=poison average=true]] damage.

YmOWNNVztuXt0paI.text: A large, psychedelically colored moth flies over the party, dusting the characters with strange powder. Creatures the moth flies over must succeed on a [[/save constitution dc=16]] saving throw or be &Reference[charmed] by all creatures for 1 hour.

tcoeMagicMushroo.name: Magic Mushroom Effects
tcoeMagicMushroo.description: Effects that can occur from interacting with magic mushrooms.

6JUoEepC2HyegJbj.text: The creature gains the benefits of the telepathy spell for the next 24 hours.

BxHzfQRSGY4v0W4w.text: The creature can understand and speak all languages for [[/r 1d4]] days.

eNEAYuClyxNCROU3.text: Magical mists pour out of the creature’s eyes and ears, acting as a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.IBJmWjzbQGu7M4UX]{fog cloud} spell for 1 hour that is centered on the creature and moves with it.

Hi1jFgraYdMwkmQR.text: The creature immediately casts the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.JYuRBwxpoFhXduvD]{time stop} spell, requiring no components. Constitution is the spellcasting ability for this spell.

jAsuAXMX0STt2xkA.text: Vocally, the creature can only cluck and croon like a chicken. The creature can also understand and speak to chickens. This curse lasts for 1 hour unless ended by a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.XZhdgVK3cLoxNCQl]{remove curse} spell or similar magic.

MKqJX2Q4YbGAM8uX.text: The creature immediately casts the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.ppWAAEul0QHtm4er]{detect thoughts} spell, requiring no components. Constitution is the spellcasting ability for this spell.

Pjhzl5EHq0tYdvLN.text: The creature gains the enlarge or reduce effect (50 percent chance of either) of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.WahI41a3goVUg0x1]{enlarge/reduce} spell for 1 hour.

qqFBYEv3ddRHjUwn.text: The creature gains the benefits of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.2VXGS206tuChoeXy]{speak with plants} spell for 8 hours.

SA1FlftMLy6QRJ44.text: The creature’s skin turns an unusual color. Roll [[/r 1d4]]: 1, purple with yellow splotches; 2, bright orange with tiger stripes; 3, tree-frog green with red squiggles; 4, hot pink with yellow spots. This change is permanent unless removed by a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.WzvJ7G3cqvIubsLk]{greater restoration} spell or similar magic.

0FFV8ofqpJBz0SZk.text: Book pages, origami, quills, and ink, all accompanied by rustling sounds and library scents

2MpaTeljjpXwMYzc.text: Brine-scented shapes of sharks, jellyfish, octopuses, and other sea creatures

6sUhgJo7NgIgugyi.text: Manifestations of deep emotions, like the faint shackles of melancholy, sepia shades of nostalgia, or heart-shaped bursts of affection

BtvHWvXE0kHCkx73.text: Transparent weapons, armor, miniature war machines, and phantom soldiers

K0eSqrm2MIi6jSfs.text: Food or utensils that carry the scent of cuisine from the spellcaster’s homeland

P9EhPP51eeVOKVVP.text: Golden rays that carry faint warmth and the hint of windblown sand

PExqGbTEPGMLxnjI.text: Rich, copper scents accompanied by what appears to be the caster’s own imbalanced humors

prqIplx7CCTBa9Y5.text: Tiny whimsical or fearsome beings from the spellcaster’s inescapable, recurring dreams

PXJLRM4R4ntNQENm.text: Bursts and strokes of watercolor painted by an invisible brush

uXIeNob9sIvC8ry8.text: Rowdy barnyard animals accompanied by the warm scents of coops and stables

tcoeManifestatio.name: Manifestations of Order
tcoeManifestatio.description: Choose or randomly determine a way your connection to order manifests while you are casting any of your sorcerer spells.

2dAJDC23dB33cEc5.text: Your skin glows with a brassy sheen.

2YfWd1zkvY1B3zDM.text: Floating equations and geometric objects overlay your body.

DBhOLPG2frcgKc2G.text: The ticking of gears or ringing of a clock can be heard by you and those affected by your magic.

r8H1RcKeQJmp7Is5.text: Your spellcasting focus temporarily takes the form of a Tiny clockwork mechanism.

UV5dvOtvZK9RPLMR.text: The hands of a clock spin in your eyes.

tcoeMercifulMask.name: Merciful Mask
tcoeMercifulMask.description: A selection of mask options for the Way of Mercy Monk subclass.

4UZ4gNkYDzq6ooGg.text: Protective Officer. A kindly officer is hesitant to send you into danger and constantly reminds you to be careful.

dScnvedEojxsgRUf.text: Bitter Soldier. Your commander carries deep grudges against your force’s enemies. They leap at any chance to do those foes harm, even if it puts your group in terrible risk.

GvFFbkbEGDPTAKFw.text: Devout Leader. Your commander is a person of deep faith. They believe that your success or failure lies entirely in divine hands and you are the instruments of that will.

kRVa1EeuGQZmtKGD.text: Taskmaster. This angry officer yells every order, reprimands you for the smallest mistake, and fully expects you to fail at every mission you undertake. This might be tough love or simple brutishness.

qMtz5P82RHthTUY3.text: Hopeful Commander. This optimistic officer knows that a new era of peace is just over the horizon. You just need to complete these last few missions, then it should all finally be over.

tuYHWiMwsCW9vQUl.text: Tested Veteran. Your commander is a battle-scarred officer who experienced horrors in combat. They rely on something to dull the pain of their memories or wounds, from a favorite writer’s prose to a distracting vice.

9IO4tamwqKiqvGbr.text: Defensive Operations. You must preserve the safety of an important location such as a civilian population center, a supply depot, or strategically critical bridge or seaport.

A6wIt9kbiFS0mzQ5.text: Reconnaissance. You gather information on enemy troop numbers, placements, movement, or supply caches and routes.

A7n3U67egzmC8gux.text: Strike Force. You undertake a quick, strategic, and devastating attack against an enemy force.

cnapsUyy4ojhphim.text: Special Forces. You are assigned to a covert operation behind enemy lines. This is similar to the work of a spy or an assassin but with a broader scope. You engage in equipment sabotage or execute targeted strikes against high-value targets.

VSG4fr3lHW11IpQK.text: Seek and Destroy. You are responsible for hunting down specific high-value and dangerous targets, which include deserters, suspected enemy special forces, or magical war machines run amok.

ZBOEyoTaRDW2shkH.text: Siege. You are assigned to initiate a siege on an enemy stronghold or help break a siege in progress on an allied fortress.

bWVQryfuWMIu9snb.text: Standing Army. A standing army serves as the highly disciplined and structured guardian of a province or an entire nation. Strict tiers of command ensure coordination between branches of the force.

MmBoiXpT6CHJgXJK.text: Planar Conscripts. This military force battles for cosmic stakes on far-flung planes of the multiverse or fights against extraplanar invasion on the Material Plane. Warriors include conscripts pressed into service in the Blood War, fodder in the thrall of ruthless yugoloth mercenaries, or members of a glorious celestial host defending against fiendish incursion.

mptARndPvUq1VKYz.text: Horde. The horde is almost a force of nature, and what it lacks in discipline it makes up in ferocity. It doesn’t have a rigid command structure, instead functioning like a pyramid of smaller armies. Horde commanders owe fealty to stronger leaders above them, all the way up to the warlord.

plpai0ZRk5nUva4E.text: Mercenary Company. Hard-bitten veterans of numerous conflicts, mercenaries serve an employer for coin rather than out of loyalty.

QCT6EqZL3SokBKzw.text: Sky Warriors. This military force consists of winged creatures, employs magical flight, or sails airships as a sky navy. Traditional defenses are ineffective against attacks from the air, positioning the sky warriors as a fearsome nation or expensive and coveted mercenaries.

wbG4j0extTyMXmHN.text: Expeditionary Force. This military force is far from home, fighting behind enemy lines or striking into wild, unsettled lands. The force must be fast, self-sufficient, and either diplomatic or decisive to assure their survival.

tcoeMirrorZoneEf.name: Mirror Zone Effects
tcoeMirrorZoneEf.description: An effect that can occur when in a supernatural Mirror Zone region.

0dCM6q4d1j1tFG85.text: A duplicate of one random creature in the region appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of that creature. The duplicate’s appearance, game statistics, and equipment are identical to the creature’s. The duplicate immediately attacks the creature, seeking to slay it. If the duplicate dies, it and all its equipment shatter into mirror shards. If the duplicate fails to slay the creature within 1 hour, the duplicate vanishes.

4So2sld2rJOfPjiL.text: The skin of one random creature in the region becomes silvery and reflective for the next 24 hours. For the duration, that creature has advantage on saving throws against spells, and spell attacks have disadvantage against that creature.

38OnC2c6Txy1KoMP.text: One character can cast the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.fVbCxFRaORalHB20]{scrying} spell ([[/save wisdom dc=17]]) once within the next 24 hours, requiring no components but using a mirror or other reflective surface.

At0KOFpk4pSN2YrR.text: Reflections of [[/r 1d4]] creatures in the region emerge from mirrors and attack. The reflections are two-dimensional, shimmering versions of the creatures that cast them. Treat the reflections as shadows that are fey instead of undead and vulnerable to bludgeoning damage instead of radiant.

ATnEJb9pgJxGcMQc.text: One random creature in the region gains the benefits of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.GSvLWcdCZLQkilXT]{blink} spell for 1 minute, shimmering with overlapping shattered reflections.

dF1Dj3HmQHBvmBCw.text: Creatures in the region begin to display features other than their own for the next 24 hours. During that time, affected creatures have advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks and ability checks made to disguise themselves.

fGMnNzd6XE3x520L.text: For the next 24 hours, when anyone in the region hits a creature with an attack roll and deals damage to it, the attacker must succeed on a [[/save charisma dc=13]] saving throw or take force damage equal to half the damage dealt.

Fn6oTawazSRZwepX.text: Creatures in the region don’t cast reflections. Wisdom (Insight) checks made against those creatures have disadvantage, and the creatures have disadvantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks made against anyone who notices their lack of reflection. When they leave the region, creatures regain their reflections, and the effect ends.

hBxb2tY42m34kNPI.text: The next time one character in the party sees their reflection in the region, that reflection of comes to life and engages its counterpart in conversation. It offers to answer one question posed to it as if the creature cast the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.XqzXSKNR75ZdYTA9]{divination} spell. After answering the question, the reflection returns to normal.

jGOsoNGna74STLNy.text: For the next 24 hours, certain wounds caused in the region attract spectral slivers of glass that cause extra damage. Any creature, other than a construct or an undead, hit by an attack that deals piercing or slashing damage begins to bleed, losing [[/damage 1d4]] hit points at the start of each of its turns. If the bleeding creature is hit by another such attack, the bleeding increases by [[/r 1d4]]. Any creature can take an action to stanch the wound with a successful [[/check skill=medicine dc=10]] check. The bleeding also stops if the target receives magical healing.

mEvusYMpY9Efgehe.text: A longsword or shortsword with a blade made of a jagged mirror appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of a random creature in the region. The weapon is a sword of wounding (see the Dungeon Master’s Guide). If the weapon’s wielder rolls a 1 or 20 on an attack roll using the weapon, the weapon shatters and is destroyed after that attack.

QGez7upm5wVYVq0a.text: Floating shards of broken mirrors swirl through the region, showing reflections of creatures and places that aren’t present, for the next minute before vanishing. On initiative count 20 (losing all ties), the shards make a ranged weapon attack (+6 to hit) against one random creature in the region. On a hit, the target takes [[/damage 3d6 type=slashing average=true]] damage.

rFJtmPcdBwFrkoGp.text: Two shimmering, vertical, reflective disks of energy appear in unoccupied spaces in the region for 1 minute. Each is 6 feet in diameter and floats 1 foot above the ground. One appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of the party. Any creature that moves through the disk instantly appears within 5 feet of the other disk or the nearest unoccupied space.

udg4bwR4ztyrEDwQ.text: One character in the region gains the benefit of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.X4c8xCkmF8U9HUMz]{mirror image} spell. The images created sometimes move or speak of their own volition.

Xv2RFiwTG99uvvsO.text: Mirrors and other highly reflective surfaces allow magical transport while in the region. Any creature that touches its reflection in an object that it isn’t wearing or carrying can immediately cast the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.wqfAVANuQonNBgnL]{misty step} spell, requiring no components.

YyPdzp88viW1rcvy.text: The @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.sTIkQK7KuQNOyY0C]{hallucinatory terrain} spell ([[/check skill=investigation dc=15]]) affects the natural terrain of the region, changing it into a different kind of terrain (DM’s choice).

tcoeMonstrosityD.description: Some desired offering options for a monstrosity.

vLmXRw0uBzpnKGLU.text: Making movements that mimic the monster’s mating dance

tcoeOozeDesires0.description: Some desired offering options for an ooze.
