9vDGXYlel38kTcf4.text: A cloth bearing a noxious odor

pO2oimx8tS5ZlTz4.text: A gallon of any effervescent fluid

tcoeOriginOfTheB.name: Origin of the Beast
tcoeOriginOfTheB.description: Such a barbarian might be inhabited by a primal spirit or be descended from shape-shifters. You can choose the origin of your feral might or determine it by rolling on this table.

6ucuGyeI6cKsDppU.text: A fey spirit gifted you with the ability to adopt different bestial aspects.

DtWjV6GHREoOczVv.text: An ancient animal spirit dwells within you, allowing you to walk this path.

hMv8PTcqZlSdW1PA.text: You are descended from an archdruid and inherited the ability to partially change shape.

PTN9RwABB68A903M.text: One of your parents is a lycanthrope, and you’ve inherited some of their curse.

tcoeOuterPlaneEs.name: Outer Essence and Property
tcoeOuterPlaneEs.description: Use this table to determine a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-tashas-cauldron.tcoe-magic-items.Item.tcoeOuterEssence]{shard's} essence and property. When you use a Metamagic option on a spell while you are holding or wearing the shard, you can use that property.

2cOBqzcNUOHcMUoh.text: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-tashas-cauldron.tcoe-magic-items.Item.tcoeLawfulEssenc]{Lawful.} You can end one of the following conditions affecting yourself or one creature you can see within 30 feet of you: charmed, blinded, deafened, frightened, poisoned, or stunned.

AG8KWBVYnAmEut5l.text: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-tashas-cauldron.tcoe-magic-items.Item.tcoeEvilEssenceS]{Evil.} Choose one creature who takes damage from the spell. That target takes an extra 3d6 necrotic damage.

oS1FrFPMXCEmsRft.text: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-tashas-cauldron.tcoe-magic-items.Item.tcoeGoodEssenceS]{Good.} You or one creature of your choice that you can see within 30 feet of you gains 3d6 temporary hit points.

PHx0XvpHMDpKNu9h.text: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-tashas-cauldron.tcoe-magic-items.Item.tcoeChaoticEssen]{Chaotic.} Choose one creature who takes damage from the spell. That target has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks made before the start of your next turn.

CKINlu0RPb6rzATc.text: The characters have united to overcome a foe.

dWwkMqAKXhDi3McP.text: The characters find themselves trapped together.

jVYZosWUdin47vEs.text: The characters were brought together by a common benefactor who wishes to sponsor their adventures.

QnDIOspVhcB1Z7Le.text: A funeral brings the characters together.

sBINQRTPJXdldrn5.text: A festival brings the characters together.

YUVnYFBctMfB93mv.text: The characters grew up in the same place and have known each other for years.

tcoePlantDesires.name: Plant Desires
tcoePlantDesires.description: Some desired offering options for a plant.

BM0tvOJCIDJAajbc.text: Clearing invasive vegetation from the creature’s territory

e7K13C2ayn9IlwcG.text: Destroying all axes and fire-making implements the party carries

NAr5jhoTbOmalbzX.text: Water from a spring infused with Feywild energy

tcoePrimalFruitE.name: Primal Fruit Effects
tcoePrimalFruitE.description: Effects that can occur when interacting with primal fruits.

2ig235hIPbpgGsE7.text: Euphoric visions of bright light swim through the creature’s mind. The creature gains the benefits of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.VtCXMdyM6mAdIJZb]{death ward} spell for 8 hours and must succeed on a [[/save constitution dc=13]] saving throw or be &Reference[poisoned] for the duration.

6aXjcMMeYiUTJGPe.text: The creature doesn’t require food, drink, or sleep for [[/r 1d4]] days. For the duration, the creature can’t be put to sleep by magic, and its dreams intrude upon its waking thoughts, imposing disadvantage on its Wisdom (Perception) checks.

EL2SQP1LLVRToqiF.text: The creature’s skin prickles faintly. For 1 hour, it gains resistance to one damage type (chosen by the DM).

LO2btgzgUkJQrM0t.text: Whispers intrude on the creature’s mind for 24 hours. For the duration, the creature can telepathically communicate with any creature it can see within 120 feet of it. If the other creature understands at least one language, it can respond telepathically.

MEmPeWHGWZkqdgHO.text: Waves of vitality crash over the creature. The creature’s hit point maximum increases by [[/r 2d10]], and it gains the same number of hit points. The increase lasts until the creature finishes a long rest, at which time the creature must succeed on a [[/save charisma dc=15]] saving throw or be cursed with a random form of lycanthropy (see “Lycanthropes” in the Monster Manual).

NfqFoEpkCuHWV8vi.text: A faint humming drones in the background of everything the creature hears for 1 hour, during which the creature has advantage on saving throws against spells.

Rlp3kOOg7PQbNz3o.text: The creature regains [[/r 3d8 + 4]] hit points, and its skin sheds bright light in a 5-foot radius and dim light for an additional 5 feet for 1 hour.

zvZLNmaW4PPBHfXL.text: The creature feels a surge of might. For 1 hour, the creature has advantage on attack rolls using Strength, Strength checks, and Strength saving throws. When the effect ends, the creature gains 1 level of &Reference[exhaustion].

tcoePsychicReson.name: Psychic Resonance Effects
tcoePsychicReson.description: An effect that can occur when in a supernatural Psychic Resonance region.

CbrxNMv8tz9KkDNO.text: Compassion and joy fill the mind of one random creature in the region for 1 minute. For the duration, the creature has advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws, and disadvantage on attack rolls.

cIilcyrg2PaeNrnH.text: For 1 minute on initiative count 20 (losing all ties), one random creature in the region must succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw or take 2d6 psychic damage.

FbrY5t3YZtx6PceW.text: One random creature in the region gains the ability to cast the telekinesis spell (save DC 15) once over the next 24 hours, requiring no components. Intelligence is the spellcasting ability for this spell.

FeK1ScsfusUj2kd6.text: One random creature in the region gains the ability to cast the detect thoughts spell (save DC 13) once over the next 24 hours, requiring no components. Intelligence is the spellcasting ability for this spell.

FRFu1EqdqKm8c5em.text: Creatures in the region suffer from disjointed thoughts and difficulty concentrating for 1 hour. For the duration, creatures have disadvantage on Intelligence checks and Constitution saving throws to maintain concentration on spells.

FrhQnP0fT1UTzWxS.text: Psychic power builds in the mind of one random creature in the region. Once within the next minute, the creature can use a bonus action to magically assault the mind of another creature it can see. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Intelligence saving throw or take 4d10 psychic damage.

GI6eu15SZE3Zy1Xl.text: Headaches and nosebleeds plague humanoids in the region, imposing disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks for 1 hour.

jM3zkUPzXtq2HD9l.text: One random creature in the region hears strange whispers in its mind. The whispers are fragments of thoughts from other creatures nearby. The creature has advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks for 1 hour.

MDk0Zhnlx15kU5dV.text: Thoughts in the region attract ambient psychic energy, forming protective fields around creatures’ minds. Creatures in the region gain resistance to psychic damage for the next hour.

muKsuPS9Q8giqbpW.text: For 1 hour, each creature in the region gains the ability to communicate telepathically with any creature it can see within 60 feet. If the target understands any languages, it can respond telepathically.

N9qDxn2Idg3ZkRYl.text: For 1 minute on initiative count 20 (losing all ties), Tiny and Small objects in the region that aren’t being worn or carried are flung by an unseen force. One random creature in the region must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 2d4 bludgeoning damage from the flung objects.

OXpoda70YsF68tQK.text: Memories become sharp and clear for 1 hour. During this time, each creature in the region adds double its proficiency bonus to Intelligence checks made to recall information.

Q8DTl1CkX6iIk7Xj.text: The mind of every beast in the region is flooded with psychic energy. This energy causes each beast’s Intelligence score to become 10, if it wasn’t already higher, and the beast gains the ability to speak Common and Sylvan fluently. These changes are permanent.

QwMbK3unlhkhAmHs.text: One random creature in the region is affected by the mind blank spell for the next 24 hours.

tF0dQZH0hovErsXw.text: One random creature in the region can sense the presence of nearby minds for 1 hour. For the duration, the creature gains advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to locate other creatures within 120 feet of it, even creatures behind total cover.

uom05q4FRwjacu85.text: Lurking fears become nightmares. Any creature that finishes a short or long rest in the region must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw or gain no benefit for finishing the rest.

bNcSDWD1egNdtCwO.text: Beloved Healer. A famed healer guides you to where you’ll be needed most, even if their reasons are unclear until you arrive.

OuPvxyrsXqNoLXiW.text: Divinity’s Voice. Otherworldly messages direct you to undertake divine quests.

P3WTeCByniYJn6rw.text: Fierce Inquisitor. A severe hierarch directs you to cleanse wickedness from a region, from the order, or from within yourself.

QXbGPBza4f1taq0Y.text: Shadow Tongue. A mysterious speaker for your order advises your next steps but fears being discovered by a powerful rival faith.

RipursIUuVg1fJUs.text: Mysterious Text. The gradual translation of a secret holy text points you toward the next step of a divine destiny.

TAdKuZslNOWClqRE.text: Inspired Creator. A gifted artisan conveys the will of the divine through prophetic song or artwork.

5TemBEWu93wsC3P0.text: Prevent Prophecy. A rival order stands on the cusp of fulfilling a prophecy with deadly ramifications. You strive to undermine their blasphemous agenda.

c5iWb36riMBr9F8c.text: Safe Escape. A band of the faithful wandered into territory hostile to your order. You must find them and escort them to safety.

ePqtYt9VgsQqR2Cm.text: Relic Recovery. You seek a lost symbol of the order discovered in a dangerous place or in the hands of an enemy.

n79RZTqQhgaSVIEu.text: Expunge Heresy. You seek out the source of blasphemy that’s taken root within the order.

OrFgBuzOMUzSCMRA.text: Desperate Pilgrimage. You protect members of the order as they participate in a pilgrimage that takes them through dangerous lands.

y02MxdmNSpRZEUvJ.text: Cult Hunt. You hunt a cell of zealots dangerous to your order or mortals at large.

8ezG7smfcmv9aaYX.text: Charitable Missionaries. Adhering to the belief that religion empowers civilization, this order travels far to help the downtrodden, seeking to draw new believers by their virtuous example.

fhETmLuNmlvXbiUG.text: Doomsaying Evangelists. This order believes the world is about to end. They’re convinced that if they persuade everyone else of this fact they might stave off the impending doom.

H8lUgDMUSjaQRRA2.text: Undead Hunters. This community of scholars and monster hunters laboriously researches the unquiet dead, tracking them to their lairs and permanently laying them to rest.

OgxTAUu4W5cGBQG2.text: Relic Collectors. This order of archaeologist-monks seeks to fill their museum-like temple with storied holy relics.

SoXAWEdCJEVoWS6L.text: Devout Scholars. This federation prizes knowledge and texts pertaining to their god. They collect rare holy books and record the life stories of miracle-working prophets.

yFrAvYiRvlYErZF0.text: Militant Inquisitors. This dogmatically rigid hierarchy seeks to stamp out all threats to their beliefs.

tcoeSoulsOfTheTa.name: Souls of the Tarokka
tcoeSoulsOfTheTa.description:
Prisoners of Fate. Whenever you use the Twist of Fate property, there is a chance that one of the souls trapped in the deck escapes. Roll [[/r d100]] and consult the Souls of the Tarokka table. If you roll one of the high cards, the soul associated with it escapes. You can find its statistics in the Monster Manual. If you roll a soul that has already escaped, roll again.

Foundry Note

This table has been configured to draw without replacement to represent the high card souls escaping. However, the result representing all other cards, 15 - 100, will always be replaced via included module functionality.

The released soul appears at a random location within [[/r 10d10#Miles]] miles of you and terrorizes the living. Until the released soul is destroyed, it gains the benefit of a weal from the deck’s Twist of Fate property, and both you and the original target of Twist of Fate suffer the effect of woe.

cGrMIhFzJhv7JRic.text: Spymaster. An intelligence operative attends to the nation’s dirty work so the sovereign keeps their hands clean.

dQWEpxkDr6FJWPS3.text: Spectral Assembly. A ghostly council of the nation’s previous regents manifests to avert disasters.

dsxluprwRWfYtpk8.text: Executive Assistant. The responsibilities of an exacting butler or other servant at the royal household far exceed their title.

hxtGcbk5hVWINi4K.text: Administrator. This severe bureaucrat disagrees with many of the sovereign’s policies but takes loyal service seriously.

iAjkkmXqIXV0C9vL.text: Intimate Confidant. The sovereign’s friend or lover seeks to aid their companion in any way possible.

XaO0PhoMdVKrFc0t.text: Envoy. A semi-retired, leisure-loving ambassador speaks in suggestion and innuendo.

04ljqKklDuZ4vHbK.text: Test Heir. You prepare the sovereign’s heir for the challenge of taking the throne.

KrgbqZDSFSLuntue.text: Desperate Diplomacy. You seek to make peace with a force or entity that could wipe out your nation.

Pv1dYsN2Wxbtz1KF.text: Expel Corruption. You help the sovereign reform their government, rooting out institutional vices.

WIygHgi5YZivU3uO.text: International Espionage. You attempt to steal intelligence, national symbols, or super weapons from an enemy power.

YC8FbhUA27qQlIy8.text: Undermine Rival. You seek to weaken or remove a rival to the regent’s rule—perhaps a general, an archdruid, or a noble with a claim to the throne.

zTNTWZSBt39UtGls.text: Subvert Blame. The sovereign is caught in an embarrassing affair. Make it disappear.

5ghhMyWXp6Saqidj.text: Village Elder. The wizened leader of a community offers both civic and moral leadership.

bHUY7wYN5CRY8TCh.text: Hidden Power. A mysterious figure manipulates the nation’s puppet leader and guides the government’s true agenda.

DzPdjHQXjOnU2hdM.text: Shipwrecked Governor. A desperate leader struggles to keep people alive in a wilderness they’re not prepared to endure.

K8721fd2zhNYQZ4G.text: True Regent. The rightful heir to the throne struggles to reclaim power from a perfect impostor.

pqnQFA4GJih1TSiK.text: Ruler Returned. A tribe’s revered leader has returned from the dead and seeks to resurrect their past glories.

Vnef9ctI9isJiymq.text: Young Noble. An ambitious noble eagerly seeks to reform society to align with a personal vision.

tcoeStarMapForm0.name: Star Map Form
tcoeStarMapForm0.description: You’ve created a star chart as part of your heavenly studies. It is a Tiny object and can serve as a spellcasting focus for your druid spells. You determine its form by rolling on the Star Map table or by choosing one.

aghPhcpiJNK66NM5.text: A stone tablet with fine holes drilled through it

B9aI6FkXkzKJwJUo.text: A speckled owlbear hide, tooled with raised marks

BMsL5MXLQmIqwiHZ.text: A collection of maps bound in an ebony cover

EbJTGBr9oKxL33MR.text: A crystal that projects starry patterns when placed before a light

KQwLc2Z4b8ktzong.text: A scroll covered with depictions of constellations

tcoeSwarmAppeara.name: Swarm Appearance
tcoeSwarmAppeara.description: A swarm of intangible nature spirits has bonded itself to you and can assist you in battle. While you’re alive, the swarm remains in your space, crawling on you or flying and skittering around you within your space. You determine its appearance, or you generate its appearance by rolling on this table.

E1CAsjjgxr35a90n.text: Bon Vivant. The boss of a local den of vice—whether gambling, narcotics, or other pleasures—aids you when they’re not distracted by their own debauchery.

hvf0SuoaudYBj32d.text: Former Law Enforcement. Your contact used to be (or maybe still is) a member of local law enforcement. They have sharp insight into the law’s workings in your area and a healthy dose of paranoia for that reason.

Juqkyqc6fbcTZ0h2.text: Personal Mentor. This longtime member of the syndicate took you under their wing when you were young and became a parental figure.

N7WKEOyxf7Rww9Sa.text: Criminal Royalty. Unknown to most, your contact is a member of local nobility or royalty. Why they maintain relations with the syndicate is a troubling mystery.

Sjet8R8J0dFThN5z.text: Traitor. You know your contact in the syndicate has betrayed it, but they have enough clout and leverage that you don’t dare cross them—yet.

Z32dOB3ZBcfvQpDz.text: Clever Urchin. An innocuous person, perhaps a beggar or menial laborer, knows all the right people and shares their connections with you.

0jmvVOXg7j8LnV8C.text: Assassination. You dispatch prominent people—the sort who have numerous bodyguards and elaborate security systems to circumvent.

4MI9HhgLtUpz3bW2.text: Heists. You plan and execute elaborate robberies that require the combined skills of your team.

6BJvyjSx9Hg2KvVy.text: Topple the Powerful. Your syndicate is criminal and your methods illegal, but your goals are righteous. You help people who are powerless against exploitation by the powerful.

6Dp9wNFq3SJU7qCt.text: Gang Warfare. You ensure that no other crime syndicate gains a significant foothold in your territory.

EcKjuzJVhpaQDMIY.text: Enforcement. You keep the corrupt, headstrong, and avaricious members of your syndicate in line with the goals and rules of the organization.

Gmt06I0czJn6AC3c.text: Acquisition and Retrieval. You acquire assets for the syndicate. You steal important documents or clear out locations for use as hideouts.

AQZNb9OKMZIsVIXw.text: Pirate Fleet. This alliance of pirate captains is unified under a ruling captain or admiral and adheres to a strict code of honor. They converge only in response to an outside threat.

dQWXJk4AYQvsa09P.text: Thieves’ Guild. A disparate convocation of thieves, spies, smugglers, and other scoundrels controls criminal activity in a region of a city.

irbeuTxWRzf7ufTQ.text: Thought Thieves. These psychic criminals infiltrate their target’s minds to steal secrets and disguise their existence.

JmCIgJs6ngSzkIeV.text: Assassin Society. The network’s livelihood is death. Members of the society hone their skills as cutthroats, poisoners, body-disposal specialists, and any other profession focused on ending lives. The society is motivated by profit or labors in service to a greater cause.

qsNv7bk5UQ7OroFF.text: Body Snatchers. The syndicate consists predominantly, if not entirely, of creatures that possess or impersonate other people. They seek to replace influential individuals throughout society with members of their ranks.

SSv8ZgTB9GesDbSo.text: Magical Arms Dealer. The syndicate has cornered the market on deadly magical devices. They offer their services and wares for a price and acquire staggering magical might for those who meet their demands.

4GlGDVitP1y8kAyg.text: The Last Tarrasque (jagged sliver of tarrasque tooth)

4su5JVv1KxhXra0i.text: Dooms of the Malpheggi (emerald lizardfolk fang)

4wDRARDQMvMflaHB.text: The Claws of Dragotha (broken translucent fang)

8GkZ8FgIjGPufjpx.text: The Thousand Deaths of Jander Sunstar (yellowed vampire fang)

8okwimEzwFZ7YcFe.text: The Staring Cats of Uldun-dar (ivory cat molar)

FM5LRQBhyHp00CwG.text: Beyond the Rock of Bral (silver mind flayer tooth)

LF3ci8XdFtDRGy5I.text: The Stable Hand’s Secret (sweet-tasting human canine)

QvwK404Lmvy6PJBs.text: Ashes of the Ages and Eternal Fire (jade humanoid bicuspid)

sfMmVIXgYcDdOOww.text: Three Bridges to the Sky (lapis lazuli oni fang)

VdCNOhRANRRidcmG.text: The Disappearances of Half Hollow (vomerine tooth of a Large toad)

1f1jgDatQF9nHgXL.text: A pair of knucklebone dice, each with a skull symbol on the side that would normally show six pips

1o0FQMfiHEyeZC9X.text: A brass orb etched with strange runes

tcoeWildMagicEru.name: Wild Magic Eruption
tcoeWildMagicEru.description:
The magical energy roiling inside you sometimes erupts from you. When you enter your rage, roll on the Wild Magic table to determine the magical effect produced.

If the effect requires a saving throw, the DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier.

gnRZAmmuWnOantOz.text: Shadowy tendrils lash around you. Each creature of your choice that you can see within 30 feet of you must succeed on a [[/save ability=con]] saving throw or take [[/damage 1d12 type=necrotic]] damage. You also gain [[/r 1d12#Temporary Hit Points]] temporary hit points.

i4J1zLaTDalSYqui.text: An intangible spirit, which looks like a flumph or a pixie (your choice), appears within 5 feet of one creature of your choice that you can see within 30 feet of you. At the end of the current turn, the spirit explodes, and each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a [[/save ability=dex]] saving throw or take [[/damage 1d6 type=force]] damage. Until your rage ends, you can use this effect again, summoning another spirit, on each of your turns as a bonus action.

m6cpBk67eC4r3dcX.text: Magic infuses one weapon of your choice that you are holding. Until your rage ends, the weapon’s damage type changes to force, and it gains the light and thrown properties, with a normal range of 20 feet and a long range of 60 feet. If the weapon leaves your hand, the weapon reappears in your hand at the end of the current turn.

R4CVbQ6tZAeq7sN9.text: A bolt of light shoots from your chest. Another creature of your choice that you can see within 30 feet of you must succeed on a [[/save ability=con]] saving throw or take [[/damage 1d6 type=radiant]] damage and be blinded until the start of your next turn. Until your rage ends, you can use this effect again on each of your turns as a bonus action.
